episodes.name: Dream Machine
episodes.overviewEn: Rocket and Groot find their dream ship in the Broker's Junkyard, but encounter one very expensive problem before they can buy it.

episodes.name: A Piece of Cake
episodes.overviewEn: In search of easy credits, Rocket and Groot take on what seems like a cute and fuzzy bounty...but it goes horribly wrong!

episodes.name: Black Tie Only
episodes.overviewEn: When his search for a bounty leads to a five-star restaurant, Rocket must defy all odds...mainly, his personal hygiene.

episodes.name: The Space Race
episodes.overviewEn: Rocket's scheme to win a space race gets thwarted by his arch-nemesis, Blackjack O'Hare.

episodes.name: Space Walk
episodes.overviewEn: A makeshift repair leaves the duo floating in space.

episodes.name: Shapeshifter
episodes.overviewEn: Rocket and Groot's friendship is put to the test!

episodes.name: Golden Nuggets
episodes.overviewEn: Rocket's on the hunt for some very valuable minerals.

episodes.name: Short Cut
episodes.overviewEn: Rocket attempts a shortcut to Groot's favorite diner.

episodes.name: Distractions
episodes.overviewEn: Rocket and Groot crash a fancy dinner party.

episodes.name: It's the Little Things
episodes.overviewEn: Rocket faces off against a wire-eating rodent.

episodes.name: Desperate Measures
episodes.overviewEn: Rocket is torn between credits and friendship.
